meta.title: Elevated
meta.author: Puryx (Rgba & TBC)
meta.description: The soundtrack of Elevated by Rgba & TBC (April 2009), a 4k intro that won the PC 4k intro competition at Breakpoint 2009 and the Scene.org Award for best 4k intro (pouet 52938, Demozoo 102). Music by Puryx (Christian Rønde); visuals by iq, synth and optimization by Mentor (Rune L. H. Stubbe) (the intro's nfo and its source release). It is played by Mentor's 4k synthesizer: per synth three oscillator pairs, an envelope, a pitch drop and noise, through a tree of filter, delay, distortion and mixer machines. 127 BPM, 3:37, 12 synths, 1509 notes. This is an adapted version, not the original recording: the song file (music.asm) was converted by `synth-convert elevated` to the unified synth (pair oscillators, linear timed envelope, pitch drop; the machine tree as tracks, effect devices and mix buses) and imported with `song import` (notes rounded to 960 ticks per beat). Against the original synth code it differs by -0.03 dB loudness and at most 0.51 dB in any octave band, and it passes the timing check against a capture of the released intro (tools/elevated-parity). Track names are derived here from each track's notes; the song file does not name them. Elevated's source release states the Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported licence for its code and music, so this adapted version is under the same licence. It is published here as an adapted reference copy while the authors are asked for permission, and is removed at their request.
